description: Frozen final model, recorded before the holdout season is evaluated. Do not edit this file after the holdout evaluation.
feature_source: data/processed/features.parquet with the Elo columns recomputed under the elo settings above (src/tuning.py with_elo)

model.preprocessing_fitted_on: training window only (refitted for every test season)

training.scheme: walk-forward by season: each test season trains on every match dated before it

random_seeds.final_model: none needed: lbfgs logistic regression is deterministic

not_adopted: Stage 8 availability and form groups (suspension, squad_value, form, recent_absence) were tested as an offset on this model under a pre-registered rule and not adopted.
